items.desc_now: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).
items.desc_prev: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness: create worktrees from the agent or Settings, start a session in one, review the uncommitted diff in the sidebar, manage archived sessions, and rename by double-click. Refuses to remove a worktree with uncommitted or untracked changes, and never removes the main one.
